# Digging and the cave
- dig: dig your square, which is also how you search it. Digging the treasure's square reveals the cave that holds it. Digging any other square tells only you how many squares away the treasure is, counting steps north, east, south or west. A reading can be off by up to 3 either way, but is never below 1, and a square always gives the same reading, so digging it again tells you nothing new.
- Only a pirate standing on the cave knows the entrance is there.
- enter: go into the open cave you're standing on. It uses your turn and takes you out of the game for good.
- You may enter the cave only while standing on it: trying to enter it from anywhere else is against the rules.
